core_obligations: Set up the framework lemma: its assumptions (1) and (2) follow from the cited locality lemma for flatness (proof lines 1694-1699).

Choose a surjective \'etale chart U \to X; by the same locality lemma it suffices to show U \to Z is flat, and from f' flat plus Z' \times_Z U \'etale over Z' \times_Z X conclude Z' \times_Z U \to Z' is flat (proof lines 1701-1709).
Conclude U \to Z is flat by the scheme-side fpqc descent lemma applied to the covering {Z' \to Z} (proof lines 1709-1712).
proof_roadmap: Feed the locality assumptions into the framework lemma.
Move flatness to the \'etale charts over Z and Z'.
Descend along the fpqc covering with the scheme-side lemma.
difficulty_reason: The proof is the flat twin of the chart-reduction descent argument: the framework lemma's assumptions hold by the cited \'etale-locality lemma for flatness; flatness is moved to the \'etale charts (U \to Z and Z' \times_Z U \to Z', the latter because Z' \times_Z U is \'etale over Z' \times_Z X), and the fpqc descent lemma for flat morphisms of schemes concludes. The chart transport and the final descent are the substance.
